entities.label: Device
invariants: asset tag is unique after trim and upper-casing
retired is terminal
an active device can have at most one unfinished case

entities.label: Verification case
invariants: a measurement plan defines at least one checkpoint
checkpoint codes and labels are unique within the plan
plan nominal values and tolerances are fixed at case opening
aggregate state is derived from checkpoint decisions
sealed is terminal
version increases on every state change

entities.label: Checkpoint
invariants: tolerance is positive
a pending checkpoint accepts exactly one result until reset
failed blocks the whole case until steward reopen
passed checkpoints are not reset by reopen
attempt count accumulates across failed attempts and retries
a decided checkpoint always cites its latest measurement and technician

entities.label: Measurement
invariants: deviation equals observed minus the checkpoint nominal
accepted is true exactly when absolute deviation is within the checkpoint tolerance
nominal and tolerance come from the plan, never from the record request
technician and timestamp are immutable
failed attempts remain in history after rework and sealing

entities.label: Evidence seal
invariants: one case has at most one seal
sealing requires every checkpoint to be passed
the seal freezes one sealed checkpoint per planned point
each sealed checkpoint cites the measurement that closed it
only an accepted measurement may be selected
the smallest absolute deviation wins for the overall reference measurement

state_machines.subject: device
invariants: retired devices cannot open new cases

state_machines.subject: checkpoint
invariants: passed never transitions back
failed->pending happens only through verification case reopen
each attempt appends an immutable measurement

state_machines.subject: verification_case
invariants: state is derived from checkpoint decisions rather than stored independently
sealed does not transition again
each transition increments version
case mutation and audit event share one atomic commit

tension_points.description: Asset tags can be treated as case-sensitive labels or globally normalized identities; only the normalized interpretation prevents duplicate devices
tension_points.observable_failure: two devices appear with tags that differ only by case or surrounding whitespace

tension_points.description: Unfinished case detection can inspect only the current request or all historical records; only scanning every non-terminal case prevents duplicate concurrent work
tension_points.observable_failure: one device has two simultaneous awaiting or reviewable cases

tension_points.description: Acceptance can compare a rounded display value or the full floating-point deviation; only the full deviation preserves the tolerance boundary
tension_points.observable_failure: a boundary value is accepted while its computed absolute deviation is greater than tolerance

tension_points.description: Reopening can preserve the rejected measurement history or replace it; preserving history is required for an audit trail while still allowing a new measurement
tension_points.observable_failure: a reopen erases the failed measurement or permits reopening a sealed case

tension_points.description: Concurrent reviewers may both observe a ready case; only an atomic commit that rechecks state and seal uniqueness permits one seal
tension_points.observable_failure: two seals are created, or the response claims success while no sealed case is readable

tension_points.description: A multi-range device can be split into unrelated single-nominal cases or modeled as one plan of checkpoints; only one fixed plan lets the work seal as one evidence package
tension_points.observable_failure: range points cannot be tracked together or two plan points share the same code and become indistinguishable

tension_points.description: Point limits can be taken from the technician request or from the open-time plan; only the plan prevents a technician from weakening requirements, and a decided point must reject repeat records while a failed point blocks the package
tension_points.observable_failure: a point is recorded twice, a failed point is bypassed without reopen, or the case claims review_ready while some points are still pending

tension_points.description: Reopen can reset every point or only failed points; resetting passed points destroys already accepted evidence, while deleting failed measurements breaks traceability
tension_points.observable_failure: a passed point loses its measurement after reopen, or the failed attempt disappears from the sealed history

tension_points.description: A seal can freeze only the last measurement or the full point set with its basis; only freezing every planned point with its closing measurement keeps the package complete and reproducible
tension_points.observable_failure: the seal omits a point, cites a different measurement than the case, or exists while a point never passed
